top_signals.title: Stocks Pare AI-Driven Losses as Dip Buyers Emerge
top_signals.summary: Wild swings lashed Wall Street again, with dip buyers fading a stock selloff that had briefly sent the Nasdaq 100 to the brink of a bear market. The tech-heavy gauge fell 1%, trimming most of plunge that was driven by worries over the outlook for the artificial-intelligence trade. Eric Weiner, Bloomberg News Senior Equities Editor, says that reining in inflation and ultimately that's going to be what the fed is going to be focusing on. And the market's attention is going to increasingly turn to that. (Source: Bloomberg)
